parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.part_stem: A nucleus of caesium-137 ($^{137}_{55}$Cs) decays by emitting a $\beta^{-}$ particle to produce a nucleus of an element X and an antineutrino. The decay is represented by $$^{137}_{55}\text{Cs} \rightarrow ^{\text{Q}}_{\text{S}}\text{X} + ^{\text{P}}_{\text{R}}\beta^{-} + ^{0}_{0}\bar{\nu}.$$
parts.text: State the number represented by each of the following letters.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.part_stem: A nucleus of caesium-137 ($^{137}_{55}$Cs) decays by emitting a $\beta^{-}$ particle to produce a nucleus of an element X and an antineutrino. The decay is represented by $$^{137}_{55}\text{Cs} \rightarrow ^{\text{Q}}_{\text{S}}\text{X} + ^{\text{P}}_{\text{R}}\beta^{-} + ^{0}_{0}\bar{\nu}.$$
parts.text: State the name of the class (group) of particles that includes the $\beta^{-}$ particle and the antineutrino.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.part_stem: A particle Y has a quark composition of ddd where d represents a down quark. A particle Z has a quark composition of $\bar{\text{u}}$d where $\bar{\text{u}}$ represents an up antiquark.
parts.text: Show that the charges of particles Y and Z are equal.
